data.name: settings.linkly.sop.manual.title
data.value: Manual amount on the terminal (standalone)

data.name: settings.linkly.sop.manual.steps
data.value: 1. Use this only when ANZ Worldline has configured the terminal for standalone operation. Standalone sales are not sent from HB POS. 2. On the terminal home screen, key in the purchase amount and press OK or ENTER. 3. Ask the customer to tap, insert, or swipe, then follow any account and PIN prompts.

data.name: settings.linkly.sop.manual.warning
data.value: If an integrated terminal does not accept an amount, contact ANZ Worldline on 1800 039 025 or your installer to change its configuration. Do not try unconfirmed Func codes.

data.name: settings.linkly.sop.ip.title
data.value: Switch HB POS to a Linkly EFT-Client IP connection

data.name: settings.linkly.sop.ip.steps
data.value: 1. Confirm ANZ Worldline or your installer has configured the terminal for integrated operation. PC settings alone do not convert a standalone terminal. 2. On the Windows PC, open Linkly Configuration Wizard. Set the Pinpad port to match the terminal connection. Select TCPIP only when the terminal itself connects over IP, then apply the change. 3. In HB POS, select Local IP / Port and clear Use Linkly Cloud. 4. Set Host to the PC running Linkly EFT-Client. Use 127.0.0.1 on the same PC. The default EFT-Client TCP port is 2011. 5. From another POS PC, use the EFT-Client PC's LAN IP. Allow TCP 2011 through Windows Firewall and add the POS IP to the EFT-Client access list if that list is enabled. 6. Click Test Linkly. After it succeeds, click Enable Linkly.
